lines.narration: You're the last doctor on Earth. Nobody is coming.
One patient is still breathing in your dark ward.
The blood bank keeps for a few weeks. Then it's empty.
Insulin survives only in the cold. The power died last night.
Triage is simple now. Save the ones you can reach.
Your hands remember what the machines used to know.
Out there, whole towns are still waiting for help.
The last supply truck never made it.
You mark every town you couldn't reach.
At dawn, you still have one patient, one job.
Because someone always has to stitch.
So you wash your hands, check the lamp, and begin again.
